content: For medical emergencies such as chest pain, difficulty breathing, severe bleeding, stroke symptoms, or suicidal thoughts, call your local emergency hotline immediately or go to the nearest hospital emergency department. Do not wait. Our Emergency Department is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Our hospital is open 24/7 for emergency care. Outpatient clinics operate Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and Saturday, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. We are closed on Sundays and public holidays for outpatient services.

Gabay General Hospital is located at 123 Health Avenue, Medical District, Metro Manila, Philippines. You can reach our main line at (02) 8123-4567. Parking is available in the basement and multi-level car park.

We offer a wide range of healthcare services including emergency medicine, internal medicine, pediatrics, cardiology, obstetrics and gynecology, surgery, radiology, laboratory, pharmacy, physical therapy, and mental health services.

To schedule an appointment, call our patient services line at (02) 8123-4567 ext. 100, or visit our website at www.gabaygeneralhospital.com. Walk-in patients are welcome but appointments are prioritized. Please bring a valid ID and your insurance card if applicable.

Visiting hours are daily from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM. A maximum of two visitors per patient is allowed at a time. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. Visitors may be restricted in the ICU and isolation rooms.

We accept PhilHealth and most major HMOs and private insurance plans. For billing inquiries, visit the Billing Office at the ground floor or call (02) 8123-4567 ext. 200. Co-pays are collected upon registration.

We offer flu vaccines, COVID-19 vaccines and boosters, and routine childhood immunizations. Vaccination clinics are held Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Walk-ins are welcome, but you may schedule ahead through patient services.

Our Pediatrics Department provides well-child checkups, immunizations, treatment of common childhood illnesses, and newborn care. Pediatric clinic hours are Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. A pediatrician is on call 24/7 for emergencies.

Our Cardiology Department offers ECG, echocardiography, stress testing, and consultation for heart conditions such as hypertension, chest pain, and arrhythmias. If you are experiencing chest pain or difficulty breathing, seek emergency care immediately.
